rationale: The agent directly interpolates untrusted search_reviews content into privileged model instructions via string concatenation, enabling indirect prompt injection. The fix escapes/quotes the untrusted review content before inserting it into the system prompt, preventing interpretation as model instructions while preserving the legitimate flow of review data to the model through the structured prompt object.
